# Sanctuary Fitness, Clydebank

> Private coached gym in Clydebank Business Park run by Stevie Fulton (coaching since 2010). Small coached classes, small-group Personal Training slots, one-to-one Personal Training and a nutrition plan. Beginners are most of the class.

Facts (quote these exactly):
- Address: Spectrum House, 1A North Avenue, Clydebank Business Park, Clydebank G81 2DR. Free parking. Five minutes' walk from Singer station.
- Contact: WhatsApp or call 07376 941421, email sanctuary@clydebankpt.com. The way in is a free ten-minute consult at the gym or on the phone.
- 8-Week Package: £205, one payment, no contract. Every coached class on the timetable, small-group Personal Training slots, a nutrition plan written for you, measurements in week one and week eight. Classes are capped at 25.
- One-to-one Personal Training: £295 for ten sessions over five weeks, nutrition included, kids welcome.
- Next 8-Week Package starts Monday the 28th of September 2026.
- Timetable: Seven coached classes a week: 6am classes Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday, Personal Training 6am to 10am Tuesday to Friday, 5:40pm classes Monday to Wednesday, Personal Training 5pm and 6pm Thursday, Saturday 9am Full Body Workout. Personal Training slots 6am to 10am Tuesday to Friday and 7am and 8am on Saturday. Every class is 60 minutes.
- Reviews: Google 4.9 from 74 reviews. Facebook 100% recommended.
- There is no free trial week. There is no lunchtime class. No supplements are sold.
